verdict.rationale: OpenHands supports CLI mode with auto-approve for non-interactive runs, API support for automation/scripting, webhook/schedule-triggered automations (Slack, GitHub, Linear), and can run headless in Docker/VMs/servers — all consistent with CI/automation usage. Missing for 10: an explicit first-party CI pipeline example (e.g., GitHub Actions config) or independent hands-on confirmation of headless CI runs.
